verdict.rationale: An agent API with tool calling could plausibly accept user-supplied MCP servers, so this axis applies. However, the MCP evidence only covers Perplexity running as an MCP server (remote and local) that other clients consume, including via Anthropic's MCP connector. The Agent API's documented tools are Perplexity-hosted built-ins (search, URL fetch, sandbox), with no documented way to attach external MCP servers.
